descriptionChirho: An organized military body or assembled force, whether of a nation, king, or God; the most common sense of the word, used for armies in battle, numbered troops, and hosts of heaven.
The activity or state of waging war; a military campaign or battle as an event rather than the force itself.
Appointed period of hard or compulsory service, whether military conscription or burdensome toil, as in Job 7:1 and Isaiah 40:2 where life itself is compared to forced labor.
